Jedes Team baut seinen eigenen Turm. Jed: Each team builds its own tower. Every written letter comes out of the portal and becomes a building block – the nicer, the taller (1 to 5 stars). Alien Zork flies each block onto the right tower with his tractor beam. If he has too much to do, he simply clones himself! Whoever builds past the finish line first wins.
Jedes Team schreibt Buchstaben und Zahle: Each team writes letters and numbers on small slips. Under the camera, every character becomes a figure with 1 to 5 stars – the nicer the writing, the more. Every star is a hit: when two figures meet, they knock stars off each other. At the opposing castle, every hit pops a soap bubble. The bubble machine blows new ones until its tank is empty. Whoever pops all of the opponent’s bubbles first wins!
